description: A FACTUAL record of a court's OWN published decision (case-history), ingested from pre-published public records into the etzhayyim global judiciary corpus. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D4/§D5/§D6. CONSTITUTIONAL: (passive-ingestion, G3) pre-published public records only — no scraping behind auth, NO sealed / juvenile / in-camera decisions. (pseudonymization, D6) litigant and third-party PII is pseudonymized per the source-jurisdiction rule (France art.33 / GDPR / APPI) before projection; `pseudonymizationApplied` MUST be true. (G19 judge-analytics prohibition) the record may reference the presiding judge via judgeReference (noAnalytics) but MUST NOT carry any evaluation/score/prediction keyed on judge identity — judge profiling is criminal in France (loi 2019-222 art.33). This record reports what the court decided as a fact; it is NOT etzhayyim adjudicating (cf. danjo non-adjudication). Source-provenance ≥1 public CID.

presidingJudgeRef.description: Optional reference to an com.etzhayyim.judiciary.judgeReference (factual; noAnalytics). MUST NOT be used to score/predict the judge (G19).

citation.description: Official public citation / docket as published.

outcomeSummaryCid.description: CID of the published decision text (pseudonymized). The court's ruling as a FACT, not etzhayyim's adjudication.

passiveIngestion.description: Pre-published public records only; no sealed/juvenile/in-camera (G3).

pseudonymizationApplied.description: Litigant/third-party PII pseudonymized per source-jurisdiction rule before projection (D6).
